#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 13-fuego

#! expect A coop: test flag FireTemple_Room10_KeeseDead_01 \(0x2f7b8a92\) = 1: queued within limpia..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x2f7b8a92 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within limpia..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0xa8906e79adeb7b16 = 1: queued within contador..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0xa8906e79adeb7b16 \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within contador..end
#! expect A coop: test flag FireTemple_Room24_FlareDancerisDead \(0x6840e510\) = 1: queued within limpia2..end
